fact: 203 civil servants of the Agnéby-Tiassa region were trained 17 June to 23 July 2025 by SNDI; the SNDI director general said more than 31,000 state officials nationwide have received this training.
title: Côte d'Ivoire-AIP/ 203 fonctionnaires et agents de l'Etat de l'Agnéby-Tiassa formés à l'usage adéquat des outils informatiques
